instruction.text: You’re talking with a historian about the importance of the Magna Carta. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Why is the Magna Carta so important?
The Magna Carta gave people ((animals ++rights)) and introduced the idea that no one is above the ((++law roof)).
Did it help in any other ways?
It inspired lots of other important ((++documents games)), like the US Constitution.

hint.label: US Constitution
hint.text: The US Constitution is a list of rules and rights for the American government and people.

atoms.b: Is the Magna Carta still used today?
Most of the 63 ((events ++clauses)) aren’t used today, but some are still used in UK law.

instruction.text: Do you think these ideas from the Magna Carta are still used today?

atoms.a: People can’t be sent to prison without a good reason.
Judges have to be honest and fair.

instruction.text: In which three places do you think you can find original copies of the Magna Carta?

feedback.finish: There are only four remaining copies. Two of them are in the British Library, and the others can be found in Lincoln Castle and Salisbury Cathedral.
